desk:
**BLUF:** The OSINT/defence community is focused on escalating tensions in the Strait of Hormuz and Red Sea, with Iranian naval claims, Saudi intercepts of Houthi drones, and U.S. political warnings. The single most important thread is IRGC-N strikes on vessels and preemptive U.S. signals of action.

## MAIN THREADS
### Strait of Hormuz Escalation
- [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2113232275659743740) reports IRGC-N claiming responsibility for attacks on seven vessels (four in simultaneous ship-to-ship transfers, three by mines), warning of further strikes on U.S. bases.
- [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2113232275659743740) notes shift from prior mine claims, with U.S. disputing and attributing to missiles/drones.
- [@Osinttechnical](https://x.com/Osinttechnical/status/2113298483948228726) and [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2113298368092942531) highlight Trump statements that Iran is driving up oil prices ahead of U.S. midterms and reiterating no nuclear weapon.

### Saudi Defenses vs. Houthis
- [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2113235747289321800) cites Saudi-led coalition confirming interception of four drones near Riyadh and Madinah, plus six more in last 24 hours.
- Multiple accounts note ongoing Houthi activity tied to broader regional dynamics.

### Ukraine Strikes on Russian Rear
- [@Osinttechnical](https://x.com/Osinttechnical/status/2113164385095237737) reports Ukrainian attack drones hit Russia’s 75th Arsenal in Moscow Oblast, targeting Buk and S-300V repair facilities.
- [@Osinttechnical](https://x.com/Osinttechnical/status/2113164388605870229) shares geo confirmation of related imagery.

### Canada-Türkiye Strategic Partnership
- [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2113295343718691154) details new four-pillar deal (trade, defense, energy, culture) announced during Carney visit, including nuclear and critical minerals cooperation.

### France Security Measures
- [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2113237592573374712) covers Macron convening emergency meeting ahead of weekend protests after prior riots.

## CONTESTED
Nothing contested.

## SINGLE-SOURCE CLAIMS
- [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2113305725489283265) (unconfirmed): Full text of Mecca Joint Defense Agreement between Saudi Arabia, Türkiye, and Pakistan published and sent to Turkish Parliament. 
- [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2113232275659743740) (unconfirmed): IRGC-N struck four vessels simultaneously during ship-to-ship transfers.
- [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2113295343718691154) (unconfirmed): Canada-Türkiye deal includes viability talks on expanding Türkiye’s nuclear power capacity.

## WORTH WATCHING
Analysts tracking further IRGC-N moves in Hormuz and any U.S. kinetic response; Saudi coalition intercepts; Ukrainian deep strikes on Russian SAM repair sites; and Turkish parliamentary vote on the Mecca pact.
